rfm.title: RFM mode
rfm.body: The ranking uses only recency, frequency and value of orders, plus open tasks and stale deals. No machine learning is involved. The list shows who to contact; it does not predict what a contact will do.

ml.title: ML ranking
ml.body: The ranking uses uplift scores from the active model. The reasons say why a contact is listed. The scores are estimates, not proof of an effect.

ml.title: Machine learning
ml.subtitle: Whether this organization uses machine learning. Admins only.
ml.explanation: When ML is on, you can run scoring with the active model. After a run completes, the priority list and campaign targeting can use its scores. Every score shows its model, version and data source. Turning ML off returns the priority list to RFM.
